verdict.rationale: Mem0's core add/search API is well documented and runtime-verified (client.add, natural-language search, CLI add/search/get/list, pip/npm SDKs installable) and semantic reranking plus entity/session scoping support persistence across sessions. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of recall/retrieval quality beyond vendor docs, and community evidence noted it doesn't learn implicit behavioral patterns, so semantic-recall quality claims are only partially corroborated outside first-party sources.
